scope: Local workshop creation/editing, dedicated Agenda dates and revision-bound administrative purchase

cases: six historical migrations reconstruct the exact Sandbox workshop catalog
all seven module tables enable RLS and deny direct client writes
replacement preserves historical authorization, purchase and payment records
both public and private historical review entrypoints are retired for all client roles
historical request IDs and received-payment references cannot be spent again
review preserves schedule permissions and active account/studio restrictions
only authenticated staff with sales/schedule permissions in this studio can attest
pending/absent confirmation and unsupported currency/method are rejected
review records the real actor and database quote without reserving or selling
cross-studio students/offers, duplicate selection and required enrollment fail closed
both unsafe RPCs and direct evidence writes are inaccessible
authorized individual checkout persists one sale/payment and every reservation
review replays reordered sessions but rejects changed amount, mode, student or reference
checkout rejects missing evidence, another tenant and a changed checkout key
overpayment, inadequate deposit and a missing balance date are rejected
deposit checkout preserves balance/policy and replay survives subsequent payments
price/deposit changes after review cannot silently change the authorized purchase
a full session after review leaves authorization and all financial rows untouched
induced second-reservation failure rolls back sale, payment, reservations and consumption
evidence cannot be edited/deleted, including by its database owner
two independent connections consume the same authorization exactly once
two independent buyers of the last seat produce one sale and one unconsumed authorization
expired sessions and disabled payment methods cannot be attested
authenticated context scopes offers, students, prices and cupos to this studio
read context hides student identities without students.read and refuses writes
admin action RPC atomically buys selected individual dates with a deposit and stable replay
admin RPC denies service/anonymous callers and cross-studio or inactive students
booking/enrollment domain blockers roll back even the received-payment authorization
admin transaction requires explicit receipt attestation and rejects altered replay parameters
two authenticated administrative buyers serialize the last seat with no losing authorization
editor context and save require active schedule/products permissions in this studio
creation creates dedicated Agenda dates with studio timezone and preserves inherited policy
creation and edits are idempotent, including simultaneous retries
invalid date, foreign discipline, insufficient space and conflicts roll back all authoring rows
unsold edit preserves existing session identity and retires removed dates without deletion
stale edits and cross-offer session reassignment are rejected
commercial history freezes prices/policy/dates while allowing an audited name-only edit
unconsumed reviewed payment and historical reservations also freeze configuration
changed prices reject stale checkout without recording an unexpected balance
concurrent purchase/edit yields either a frozen edit or a stale checkout, never a mixed contract
regular packages cannot enter owned or retired workshop dates; legacy/normal rules remain intact
integration.database: Isolated PostgreSQL 17, networking disabled, no remote records; real workshop migrations over reduced external host fixture

editorBrowser.scope: Component smoke; action/Link doubles, no real login, Next transport or UAT
checks: Conflict preserves name, exact decimal prices, policy and both selected dates
Create retry keeps request/payload and submits two dates, exact minor units and inherited enrollment
Successful response replaces form with saved workshop link
390px mobile creation form has no horizontal page overflow
Locked workshop disables configuration and submits only name plus optimistic revision

purchaseRegressionBrowser.scope: Component browser smoke with action/Next Link doubles; not real authentication, Next server-action transport or UAT
checks: Explicit selection of every individual date keeps the individual total of 450 vs full price 600
Rejected action preserves student, selected dates, amount, reference and receipt attestation
Retry keeps the exact checkout key/payload and a successful response replaces the form with a receipt
390px mobile viewport has no page-level horizontal overflow
Required enrollment and missing write permissions keep checkout disabled

checks.build: passed with public dummy build values

limitations: External auth/studio/Agenda/financial tables are reduced fixtures; external booking/enrollment engines are contract doubles.
Browser checks use real components/CSS with action and Link doubles, not real authentication, Next transport or PostgREST.
Full-schema integration, generic Agenda writer concurrency and real authenticated Sandbox UAT remain pending.
